description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_InventoryRestock" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restock">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestock" name="Inventory restocking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Inventory monitoring begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_CheckThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdReached" name="Reorder threshold reached?" default="Flow_BelowThreshold">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_CheckThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThresholdReached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalChoice" name="Choose reorder signal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThresholdReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ManualCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Send automated reorder alert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Alert_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ManualCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Manual_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Merge reorder signals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Alert_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Manual_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_UpdateDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery date in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_UpdateDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Store</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Store</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Store_UpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Store_UpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_CheckThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Gateway_SignalChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockAtOrBelowReorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThreshold" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateDate" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Store" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Store_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryRestock">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Inventory" name="Warehouse or store" processRef="Process_InventoryRestock"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Supplier" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Supplier" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
